# Encode Base64

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Encodes the given input into base64 without line breaks.

## Syntax

~~~~text
encode(input: <#Variable (Optional)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
encode(input: ShortcutInput)
~~~~
